steps.name: Checkout the qualification repository at the exact event commit
Install hash-locked dependencies and prepare evidence directories
Fetch the eight pinned components by exact SHA and verify HEAD and tree
Preflight - mandatory tuple guard, then runner dry check
Frozen run - 41 cases, one attempt, no retries, no -x
Upload artifacts (junit, logs, observer output, run.json, per-test CSV, guard result, environment, SHA-256)
Gate - fail loudly if the harness did not run to a complete 41-case record
Post Checkout the qualification repository at the exact event commit
